description: Checks whether a slower carrier has come back with a better price since the options were first shown. has_improvement is true only when a new rate beats the earlier best by at least $100 a year or 5%. Useful when the customer hesitates over price after seeing options. If nothing improved, it's best to say so plainly rather than suggest a better price is coming.

quote_id.description: The quote session id to check for late-arriving carrier rates.

name: check_late_arrivals

outputSchema.description: Whether a slower carrier has beaten the first-quoted best price, plus the refreshed options.

title: Check for better late rates
